faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for District Legal Services Authority Mirzapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in District Legal Services Authority Mirzapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Stenographer (Hindi) Grade-2.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for District Legal Services Authority Mirzapur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure to this notice (page 2); also downloadable from https://mirzapur.dcourts.gov.in/ under Recruitment option) and send it to Office of District Legal Services Authority, Mirzapur, by in person or by registered post, to reach by 15 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 65 years (on the last date of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 9,000 per month fixed honorarium.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employee of the District Court or Collectorate Court whose age is less than 65 years; candidates with computer knowledge will be given preference.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Only retired employees of the District Court or Collectorate Court may apply. Candidates with computer knowledge will be given preference.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after the fixed date will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on contract basis for a maximum of 02 years.
